Ava: Heads up — biscotti drawer is down to two packets, and the Mocha pods are missing from the Nespresso bin. Anyone see them? ☕️🍪

Priya: I took one pod earlier but left a note. Sorry! I'll replace by EOD. :bow: 
Noah: Also quick poll — croissant vs banana bread for tomorrow morning? Vote with emoji :croissant: or :banana:
Sofia: CROISSANT :croissant:
Ava: +1 croissant
Priya: banana bread :banana:
Liam: croissant but make it gluten-free option if possible?
Sofia: good call, @Noah can you add GF on the order?
Noah: Yep adding GF option. Ordering via Favorables Bakery, ETA 9:15AM
Ops-bot: Reminder: kitchen inventory updated — last restock 2026-03-15.
Ava: Thanks. Also, if anyone is doing a coffee run, could you grab a pack of mocha pods (Legacy brand) and the biscotti? Reimbursable.

Priya: I'll Venmo the biscotti cost, text me.
Sofia: Also FYI, the reusable mugs are in the upstairs cabinet (labelled). Please don't stack lids inside the mugs, they warp them :grimacing:
Noah: Noted. I'll bring croissant list: 14 regular, 3 GF
Liam: Order placed: Favorables Bakery — 17 items. Confirmed pickup 08:55. Receipt in #finance-expenses later.
Ava: You're a hero. :tada:
Priya: <3
Liam: Also added a sticky on the Nespresso: "Mocha pods — do not relocate" :memo:
Sofia: LOL :joy:
Ava: OK thread closed unless we need extra almond milk. I'm allergic but can bring oat if needed.
Noah: Bring oat please.
Ava: Done. Thanks everyone!
